results.test_desc: Ensure that the etcd data directory ownership is set to etcd:etcd (Automated)
results.remediation: On the etcd server node, get the etcd data directory and run chown etcd:etcd.
test_info: On the etcd server node, get the etcd data directory.

results.test_desc: Ensure that the API server pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
results.expected_result: permissions has permission 600, expected 600 or more restrictive

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of privileged containers (Manual)
results.remediation: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of privileged containers.

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host network namespace (Manual)
results.remediation: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of hostNetwork containers.

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of root containers (Manual)
results.remediation: Create a policy for each namespace in the cluster, ensuring that either MustRunAsNonRoot or MustRunAs with the range of UIDs not including 0, is set.
